_readme: Which English value each satellite translation was recorded against. Read through
An entry is a digest of the neutral value the translation was stamped against, so a fresh verdict
means the English has not moved since the stamp. It does not mean anybody confirmed the translation
was made from that English, and keeping those two apart is what this file is for: a generator MAP
entry is 'Key': translation and records no source English, so a slot filled by --record-all-current
carries an assumption rather than a record. The two answers below are what stop an assumption
A key with no entry here is one this check makes NO claim about, and it says so on every run.
A key whose entry is the literal string 'unverified' is reported as unverified and never as a pass.
